name.description: Human-readable name for the SQL variable.

type.description:
Variable type. Controls how the value is rendered and substituted in HogQL.

* `String` - String
* `Number` - Number
* `Boolean` - Boolean
* `List` - List
* `Date` - Date

default_value.description: Default value used when a query references this variable.

created_by.description: ID of the user who created the SQL variable.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the SQL variable was created.

code_name.description: Generated code-safe name used in HogQL as {variables.code_name}. Derived from name.

values.description: Allowed values for List variables. Null for other variable types.
